text.short: Chino, on Chino Avenue. Weekday mornings only — a Basque and Mexican counter with a full bar.
text.today: Seven to three, Monday to Friday, shut at the weekend. Bread comes out with whipped butter and salsa, which is the whole story of this room in one plate.

seating.note: A breakfast and lunch room; you take a table.

picon.note: There is a full bar. Nothing published says what is on it.
